---
title: "Instructor Laboratory and Blackboard Readiness Checklist"
description: "A pre-course verification record for the MATH 346 computing environment."
---

::: {.callout-warning}
## Current status

The required software contract is fixed, but the **live laboratory and
Blackboard checks have not yet been recorded**. Do not tell students that an
access route is available until the corresponding evidence below has been
captured.
:::

This checklist verifies the [student software requirements](software-requirements.qmd)
on the actual systems students will use. It contains no passwords, private
student data, answer keys, or withheld project outcomes.

## Record the Test Context

| Field | Record |
|---|---|
| Date and tester | To be completed |
| Laboratory room and machine identifier | To be completed |
| Student-account type used | To be completed |
| MATLAB version and license route | To be completed |
| R, RStudio, and Quarto versions | To be completed |
| Browser and operating system | To be completed |
| Blackboard sandbox or live-course section | To be completed |

Use an ordinary student account wherever possible. Administrator access can
hide permission, installation, path, storage, or Blackboard-visibility
problems.

## Laboratory Check: MATLAB Block

- [ ] Sign in as a student and open MATLAB using the route that will be
  announced to the class.
- [ ] Download and run
  [the MATLAB setup check](../code/setup/check_matlab_setup.m).
- [ ] Record the exact MATLAB version and `MATLAB core check: PASS` output.
- [ ] Record `Symbolic Math Toolbox check: PASS`; do not infer toolbox access
  from MATLAB access alone.
- [ ] Open, edit, save, close, and reopen a `.m` file in a student-writable
  folder.
- [ ] Read a CSV and create a figure from that folder.
- [ ] Confirm that a student can preserve files after sign-out or document the
  required external/cloud-storage procedure.
- [ ] Run one representative Week 1 script and one Week 5 symbolic script.

If MATLAB Online is the fallback, repeat the check in a supported browser with
the institutional student license and confirm that Symbolic Math Toolbox is
included.

## Laboratory Check: R Block

- [ ] Open RStudio Desktop or the selected supported R editor as a student.
- [ ] Download and run [the R setup check](../code/setup/check-r-setup.R).
- [ ] Record `R and required package check: PASS` and the six printed package
  versions.
- [ ] Record `Quarto check: PASS`.
- [ ] Confirm that students may install/update packages in a personal library,
  or document the managed update process.
- [ ] Open, edit, save, close, and reopen an `.R` file and a `.qmd` file in a
  student-writable folder.
- [ ] Render the supplied Week 6 scaffold and open its HTML output.
- [ ] Run one representative Week 9 import script and the public Project 2
  starter against non-sensitive sample data.

The goal is one supported beginner workflow. Do not require students to learn
both RStudio and Positron.

## File and Report Workflow

- [ ] Download a ZIP from the course site, extract it without renaming its
  contents, and run a starter file from the extracted folder.
- [ ] Open the project report template in the supported document editor.
- [ ] Export the report to PDF and reopen the PDF.
- [ ] Confirm that the exported PDF, source file, CSV results, and ZIP fit the
  Blackboard assignment limits and permitted file types.
- [ ] Check filenames containing spaces, hyphens, and a student group code.
- [ ] Confirm that the accessibility tools students are expected to use work
  with the website, Blackboard, code editor, and report template.

## Blackboard Dry Run

Use a sandbox course or a temporary test group before touching the live student
groups.

- [ ] Create a test group with the same settings planned for the 20 groups.
- [ ] As a test student, confirm that only the assigned group ZIP is visible.
- [ ] Confirm that Project 2 training ZIPs contain no validation outcomes.
- [ ] Test the Project 1 group assignment with one submission per group.
- [ ] Test the Project 2 frozen-plan checkpoint and record all seven plan
  fields described in the project milestone map.
- [ ] Verify that the common Project 2 validation release remains hidden until
  the frozen-plan gate closes.
- [ ] Test replacement/resubmission policy, due-date display, time zone,
  receipt generation, and instructor download.
- [ ] Download a submitted package, extract it, and run the relevant checker on
  a local copy.
- [ ] Preview every item as a student and verify group membership with the
  registrar list before release.
- [ ] Record a backup release/submission route in case Blackboard is
  unavailable; do not publish withheld validation outcomes on the public site.

The full release order is in the
[project milestone map](../projects/project-milestones.qmd) and the
[instructor implementation guide](../projects/instructor-implementation.qmd).
